_comment: Temporary hand-off tracker. handoff/ holds ready-to-apply patches for upstream repos while they are still files here rather than merged PRs. When an upstream repo applies its patch, record the receiving commit SHA below, note it in handoff/README.md, and archive/remove the applied copy. handoff/ is retired once every entry below is 'applied'.

isochrones.notes: isochrones published the v2.1.0 URPS workforce artifact set (urps_counts_by_year.csv with measure x geography, urps_manifest.json, urps_provider_snapshot.parquet, urps_release_contract.json). mufflyaccess reads + validates it via use_urps_artifact() and pins it in the isochrones-integration CI job. The v2.1.0 bytes are also bundled as the bootstrap (canonical_release=false) so the default serves the corrected numbers.

cliff.notes: R/urps_baseline.R shim (v2.1.0 measure+geography API) + shared unqualified-baseline guard staged in handoff/cliff/. Switch cliff's baseline to mufflyaccess::urps_count(2023, 'board_certified_active', <geography>, include_urology). Canonical 2023 active = 1332 (national) / 1329 (conus); 1339 is the 2025 roster_snapshot, not the 2023 active count.

twostep.notes: R/urps_workforce.R (urps_workforce_n(geography, ...)) + shared unqualified-baseline guard staged in handoff/twostep/. twostep is geography-aware: the workforce total must match the geography of its denominators and isochrone bands (conus 1329 / national 1332 for 2023 active).

shared_guard.notes: Copy into each consumer's tests/testthat/. Flags 1332/1329/1339/1336 used as an unqualified baseline in production code; allows them in tests/docs/historical tables and exempts urps_count() / '# ssot-ok' lines.
